independence: Separate reviewer; independent name reconstruction and PDF-row transcription, without importing producer modules. Legal reports reviewed for methodological overstatement; not every legal search repeated.

findings.conclusion: Name normalization is a comparison key, not identity proof or automatic merge authority.
150 and 12 award keyword results overlap by 12; dot query is not a literal recipient-punctuation cohort. Three UEIs remain separate; six P/C profiles are not six companies.
Seven history rows reproduced; missing historical units and terms block comparability. Blank current quote prevents a price comparison; ceiling divided by estimate is not a price.
Analytically new is distinct from unknown to government or reward-eligible. Public-data analysis is not categorically excluded by written WHIP terms.
A universal specific-intent requirement would improperly exclude potential civil FCA theories; a price gap alone still establishes none.

Use a declared 30-RFQ commodity cohort, verify original award/order/CLIN terms and separate alternatives and novelty review. This is a feasibility judgment, not a statistical fraud-probability estimate.

issues_resolved: Actual count response and terminal empty-page evidence are validated instead of relying only on manifest claims.
Derived parent fields are bound to captured source profiles; unused all-null nested parent selections removed.
Published current-term source page corrected to page 2 and byte-identical offline replay verified.
Price eligibility gate rejects NaN and Infinity; gate cannot authenticate arbitrary provenance strings or review flags.

validation.live_price_reacquisition: Producer validation records success; reviewer independently reran only offline extraction.

unresolved: Independent legal-identity and dated beneficial-ownership proof for the neutral name records.
Historical item revision, unit, packaging, delivery, qualification and nonrecurring-cost terms; actual orders/invoices/payments.
Official audio comparison for the attributed October20 speech; current written reward-scope inconsistencies.
Current full procurement deviation text and applicable contract-date rules, some bill-number/status crosswalks and archived-code edition limits.
No basis to establish that a government investigation is absent or a researcher is eligible for payment.
No complete national population, statistical fraud probability, loss estimate or universal public-access claim.
